B67.evidence: The optional owner port and exact request checks exist, but no production producer supplies cache-reuse ownership and no product caller passes cache_reuse_authorizer in the last verified source scan; current fallback is a provider call.

B68.bounded_observation: The actual factory/CachingLLMClient, loopback provider, fixture-owned currentness authorizer, immutable FileSystemCAS snapshot, observer, budget middleware, durable ledger, and fresh reader compose. Four same-scope concurrent calls share one in-flight request and return distinct responses; one provider event and three zero-cost origin-linked reuse events are recorded. After fixture grant removal and epoch change, the same request misses. Across six calls, a reopened ledger sees two provider events and four zero-cost reuse rows.
B68.fixture_limit: Local fixtures only; no deployment owner, live provider, production permission, or cross-instance proof.
